name: Jumping-shrimp pancake
summary: A crisp coastal pancake filled with small Bình Định freshwater shrimp, named for the way they jump on the hot pan. Squid and beef versions are made too.
origin: Vietnam Tourism’s culinary journey, English and Vietnamese, under the name bánh xèo tôm nhảy.
howToEat: The name is the shrimp moving on the hot pan. Eat the pancake while it is still crisp.
where: The Xứ Nẫu coast of former Bình Định.
Quy Nhơn is the coast for lobster, crab, squid, and shellfish, at Hàm Tử port, Đầm market, and Khu 2 market. Those are separate from this pancake.
seoTitle: Bánh xèo tôm nhảy — the coastal pancake
seoDescription: Bánh xèo tôm nhảy is a crisp pancake of small Bình Định freshwater shrimp, named for the way they jump on the pan. A coastal Gia Lai plate.
